parts.question: What was the renal starting dose for moderate impairment in Germany?

result.answer: The historical renal starting dose for moderate impairment in Germany was 50 mg once daily [E1, E2]. This information comes from a superseded German product label, DE-AX17-LBL-038, which was in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15 [E1].
